ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light grey) surface area and 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pigmented regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels dominate the central and anterior regions of both lobes; low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edges, within the median notch area, and as numerous small circular high-contrast clusters scattered across the white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees; notch depth constitutes roughly 12% of the visible vertical height of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serrations along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of valleys reaches up to 10 pixels in depth, with the highest frequency of jagged peaks located on the distal half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins display a consistent convex curve from the leading edge toward the distal tips, transitioning into a jagged, irregular concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped dark pixel clusters (rosettes) measuring 5-15 pixels in diameter; heavy concentration on the outer third of both lobes against the high-intensity background.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions; notably, a series of dark vertical rake-like marks on the right lobe and faint horizontal light-colored streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of high-intensity, irregular calcified-looking clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; multiple circular puncture-style scars distributed across the mid-lobe surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips exhibit significant protrusion and textural irregularity compared to the relatively smoother leading edge.
